grain: one row per (breakdown_type, breakdown_value) where breakdown_type is 'risk_segment' or 'model_version'; a separate table has one row per rejection_reason

decision_count.business_definition: Number of underwriting decisions in this breakdown group.
decision_count.formula: count(underwriting_decisions grouped by risk_segment or model_version)

approved_count.business_definition: Decisions in this group that were APPROVED.

rejected_count.business_definition: Decisions in this group that were REJECTED.

manual_review_count.business_definition: Decisions in this group flagged for MANUAL_REVIEW.

approval_rate.business_definition: Share of decisions in this group that were approved.
caveats: Answers 'what was the approval rate this week?' when filtered by decided_at, and 'did approval rates change after the new underwriting model?' via the model_version breakdown.

avg_approved_amount.business_definition: Average approved loan amount for APPROVED decisions in this group.

avg_approved_apr.business_definition: Average approved APR for APPROVED decisions in this group.
caveats: Answers 'which customer segment received the highest rates?' via the risk_segment breakdown.

rejection_reason_count.business_definition: Count of REJECTED decisions by rejection_reason, portfolio-wide.
rejection_reason_count.formula: count(underwriting_decisions where decision == 'REJECTED', grouped by rejection_reason)
caveats: Answers 'which rejection reason was most common?'
